// Comprehensive world country data: ISO code, name, dial code
// Emoji flags are auto-generated from ISO alpha-2 codes

const getFlag = (code) => {
  if (!code) return '🌐';
  return code.toUpperCase().replace(/./g, char =>
    String.fromCodePoint(127397 + char.charCodeAt())
  );
};

  code,
  name,
  dialCode: dialCode.startsWith('+') ? dialCode : `+${dialCode}`,
  flag: getFlag(code),
  searchKey: `${name} ${code} +${dialCode}`.toLowerCase(),
})).sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));

// Priority countries to show first
export const PRIORITY_COUNTRIES = ['US', 'GB', 'CA', 'AU', 'IN', 'DE', 'FR', 'BR', 'CN', 'JP', 'NG', 'ZA', 'KE', 'EG', 'MA', 'SN', 'GH'];

export const getCountryByCode = (code) => COUNTRIES.find(c => c.code === code);
export const getCountryByDialCode = (dialCode) => COUNTRIES.find(c => c.dialCode === dialCode || c.dialCode === `+${dialCode}`);

export default COUNTRIES;
